name: ReadFromCsvFile
label: Read from CSV File
description: Reads a CSV file into a DataTable.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the CSV file to read.

fields.name: EncodingOption
fields.label: Encoding
fields.description: The encoding of the CSV file.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8
selectOptions.description: UTF-8 encoding with byte order mark.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8 (no byte order mark)
selectOptions.description: UTF-8 encoding without byte order mark.

fields.name: TrimFields
fields.label: Trim Fields
fields.description: Specifies whether to trim whitespace from the fields.

fields.name: FirstLineContainsColumnNames
fields.label: First Line Contains Column Names
fields.description: Specifies whether the first row of the CSV file contains column names.

fields.name: ColumnsSeparatorType
fields.label: Columns Separator
fields.description: The type of separator used in the CSV file (Predefined or Custom).

selectOptions.label: Predefined
selectOptions.description: Use one of the built-in predefined separators.

selectOptions.label: Custom
selectOptions.description: Define a custom separator character or string.

fields.name: PredefinedSeparator
fields.label: Predefined Separator
fields.description: The predefined delimiter used in the CSV file (e.g., Comma, Tab).

selectOptions.label: Comma
selectOptions.description: Uses a comma (,) as the separator.

selectOptions.label: Tab
selectOptions.description: Uses a tab character as the separator.

selectOptions.label: Semicolon
selectOptions.description: Uses a semicolon (;) as the separator.

fields.name: CustomSeparator
fields.label: Custom Separator
fields.description: The custom delimiter used in the CSV file.

fields.name: CsvTable
fields.label: CSV Table
fields.description: The contents of the CSV file as a DataTable.
